channel.title: Sahaj's blog
channel.description: Study notes, AI updates and paper summaries by Sahaj Saliya.

item.title: Mistral Large 4 ("Le Chonk"): ~1T-parameter MoE with sparse attention
item.description: Mistral Large 4 is a multimodal MoE of about 1T total parameters with a 1M-token context, combining expert sparsity with sparse attention and a Pixtral vision encoder, released in FP8 and NVFP4 under an MIT-derived open-weight licence.

item.title: Paper summary: ChronoReplay: One Answer Interface Is Not Enough for Streaming Spatial Intelligence
item.description: Training a spatial VLM on one kind of answer (e.g. left/right) doesn't teach related ones (e.g. distance), which the authors call "interface lock-in"; ChronoReplay replays mixed spatial supervision as time-ordered episodes and improves three streaming benchmarks together.

item.title: Paper summary: Spectral-Spatial Interpretation
item.description: Spectral-Spatial Interpretation explains multispectral image models with a full position × channel attribution matrix, using a local Shapley game at each position, so it shows which channels matter where.

item.title: Agentic AI · Agent safety
item.description: The main risks when agents act (prompt injection through tool outputs, excessive permissions, unconfirmed side effects) and simple defences: separating data from instructions, allow-lists, argument validation and human confirmation.

item.title: Paper summary: OmniCompass: A Holistic Benchmark for Omni-Modal Video Grounding and Understanding
item.description: OmniCompass is a manually annotated benchmark for video grounding and understanding, with a vision track and an audio-visual track (when, where and what); across 50 MLLMs, the best scores are only around 40%.

item.title: Built this: NLP Document Search Engine
item.description: A Gradio app for classical document search: NLTK preprocessing, a TF-IDF vector space model with cosine ranking, term-level explanations and a lexical-matching comparison mode.

item.title: Agentic AI · Agent evaluation
item.description: Evaluating agents means checking the final answer and the trajectory: task success, tool-call correctness, wasted steps and cost, scored here over a few recorded agent runs.

item.title: Built this: Social media sentiment and trend analytics on MongoDB
item.description: A Big Data Analytics course project: 2,944,814 real tweets in MongoDB, cleaned and enriched with sentiment, topics and keywords, served by FastAPI to a React dashboard, with Spark and sharding experiments.

item.title: Built this: AgentForge
item.description: A three-agent CrewAI research assistant (Researcher, Analyst, Reviewer) whose sources come only from real tool activity and whose failures are reported as failures.

item.title: Paper summary: RealCompanion: Benchmarking Human Understanding from Reasoning over Longitudinal Real-World Conversations
item.description: RealCompanion releases ten real long-term human–AI companion relationships (27,218 messages over up to 120 days) and finds that people rarely refer back, that AI can't tell when the past matters, and that it reads more into people than they revealed.

item.title: Agentic AI · Model Context Protocol (MCP)
item.description: MCP standardises how applications expose tools, resources and prompts to LLM clients; an MCP server built with the official Python SDK and queried from an in-process client.

item.title: Paper summary: Raven: The Harness of Harnesses for Composable Agentic Intelligence
item.description: Raven is an open-source multi-agent ecosystem that automatically builds and evolves specialised model–harness pairs and orchestrates them across domains through a Host Agent, with stored experience turned into reusable skills.

item.title: Hugging Face Hub adds RL environments
item.description: The Hugging Face Hub gained a filter for RL environments: an environment is a dataset repo (tasks, tests, containers and a reward rule) with a "Use this dataset" command for frameworks like Harbor, Verifiers and NVIDIA NeMo Gym.

item.title: Paper summary: RRSI: Regularized Recursive Self-Improvement of Agent Harnesses
item.description: Automatically evolving an agent's harness (prompts, control flow, tools, memory) tends to overfit the tasks it evolves on; RRSI regularises the proposal and selection steps and keeps gains on out-of-distribution benchmarks.

item.title: Agentic AI · Multi-agent systems
item.description: Multi-agent patterns (supervisor/router, sequential crew, validator) with a small supervisor that routes questions to specialist agents, and how my Multi-Agent-RAG and AgentForge projects use them.

item.title: Paper summary: Atria Dawn: The Dawn of Agentic Superintelligence
item.description: Atria Dawn Preview is an agentic language model for research and engineering trained on verified tool-mediated experience; alongside benchmarks, the paper studies 769 real task records from 56 people working with it.

item.title: Agentic AI · Agent memory
item.description: Short-term memory (the conversation in the context window) versus long-term memory (facts stored outside and retrieved when relevant), with a small long-term store built on embeddings.

item.title: Paper summary: Scaling Automatic Research Agents via World Models
item.description: RL for automatic-research agents is bottlenecked by slow, sandboxed experiment execution; World Model RL replaces execution with a learned world model plus debiasing and denoising, training 3–4× faster.

item.title: Paper summary: StudentSim: Training LLM-based Student Simulators
item.description: StudentSim trains individual student simulators from sparse per-student data (pooled training, then per-student specialisation) that both match a learner's answers and respond to tutoring; it beats GPT-5.4 on both measures.

item.title: Agentic AI · Planning
item.description: Plan-and-execute: write a plan of steps with dependencies first, then run them in order, re-planning when a step fails, implemented as a small task graph executor.

item.title: Paper summary: VGI-Bench: Probing Visual Intelligence in Video Generation Models
item.description: VGI-Bench tests visual reasoning in video generation models with 27 tasks and 810 instances that require a valid process, not just a plausible final frame; the best model, Seedance 2.0, scores 51.0%.

item.title: Agentic AI · Tool and function calling
item.description: Structured tool calling with a real local model: Python functions become JSON schemas, Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct emits tool calls through its chat template, and the app parses and executes them, including one wrong call.

item.title: Paper summary: Can We Defend Against AI-Generated Video Attacks on Real-World Crisis Events? A Systematic Evaluation of Detectors, Generators and Social Dissemination
item.description: RA-Bench pairs 1,830 real crisis videos with 16,056 generated clips from nine generators, and finds that no family of AI-video detectors generalises consistently, including when videos are re-shared on social media.

item.title: Gemini 3.7 Flash: three weeks after 3.6
item.description: Google released Gemini 3.7 Flash three weeks after 3.6 Flash, reporting large gains on coding (DeepSWE v1.1 65.3% vs 49.0%), web development and document-heavy knowledge work, at half 3.6 Flash's introductory price.

item.title: Agentic AI · ReAct
item.description: ReAct interleaves reasoning ("Thought") with tool use ("Action") and results ("Observation"); the prompt format, a parser for model output, and a full trace with a scripted model.

item.title: Paper summary: BDH-CQ: In-Context Learning with Recurrent Latent Reasoning
item.description: BDH-CQ combines in-context learning with recurrent latent reasoning in the Dragon Hatchling architecture; a 150M model reaches 29.5% pass@2 on ARC-AGI-1 at about $0.0007 per task, a new cost–accuracy frontier.

item.title: Built this: LabX
item.description: A Docker image that runs JupyterLab and a browser-based VS Code (code-server) side by side on one shared Python environment and workspace.

item.title: Paper summary: DAPD: Dual-Anchored Policy Distillation
item.description: On-policy self-distillation with a privileged teacher can cause "privilege illusion": the student acts as if it still had information it can't see at inference. DAPD anchors training along matched-information paths to prevent this.

item.title: Agentic AI · What is an agent
item.description: An LLM agent is a loop: the model decides an action, a tool runs it, the result goes back to the model, until it decides it's done; the loop written in plain Python with a scripted policy.

item.title: Built this: Explainable Student Performance Prediction Platform
item.description: An end-to-end ML platform that validates student data, benchmarks nine model types from logistic regression to an LSTM, tracks runs in MLflow, explains predictions with SHAP and LIME, and serves them through FastAPI and Streamlit.

item.title: Paper summary: Kimi K3: Open Frontier Intelligence
item.description: Kimi K3 is an open-weight 2.8T-parameter MoE (104B active) with native vision and a 1M-token context, reported as about 2.5× more scaling-efficient than Kimi K2, though still behind the strongest proprietary models.

item.title: Generative AI · Text-to-speech
item.description: Text-to-speech with a small end-to-end model (Meta's MMS-TTS English, a VITS model): text to waveform in one network, plus a look at the generated audio's waveform and spectrogram.

item.title: Paper summary: ABot-World-0: Infinite Interactive World Rollout on a Single Desktop GPU
item.description: ABot-World-0 is an action-conditioned video world model for long, closed-loop interaction that streams 720p at up to 16 FPS on a single RTX 5090, with LongForcing to limit drift over long rollouts.

item.title: Generative AI · Text-to-image
item.description: How text steers a diffusion model: conditioning, classifier-free guidance, and the guidance scale trade-off, shown with a small conditional diffusion model on 2-D data where "prompts" are cluster labels.

item.title: Inkling: a ~1T-parameter open multimodal model with 1M context
item.description: Thinking Machines released Inkling on Hugging Face, a ~1T-parameter decoder-only multimodal MoE (41B active) that takes image, text and audio, has a 1M context, and was trained on 45T tokens; a smaller Inkling-Small followed.

item.title: Paper summary: Function-Aware Fill-in-the-Middle as Mid-Training for Coding Agent Foundation Models
item.description: The authors note that an agent's act–observe–continue loop has the same shape as a function call site, and use function-level fill-in-the-middle mid-training on Python repos to improve coding agents on SWE-Bench.

item.title: Paper summary: Vidu S1: A Real-Time Interactive Video Generation Model
item.description: Vidu S1 generates infinite-length interactive video of digital characters in real time, controlled by voice at any moment, at 540p and up to 42 FPS on consumer GPUs.

item.title: Generative AI · Multimodal models (CLIP)
item.description: CLIP learns a shared space for images and text by contrastive training on image–caption pairs; zero-shot classification of photos by comparing them with text prompts.

item.title: Generative AI · Stable Diffusion
item.description: Latent diffusion runs the diffusion process in a compressed latent space from a VAE; encoding and decoding a real photo with the Stable Diffusion VAE to see the 48× compression the whole model relies on.

item.title: Paper summary: Orca: The World is in Your Mind
item.description: Orca learns one latent "world state" space from 125K hours of video and 160M event annotations via next-state prediction, and frozen, it supports text, image and robot-action readouts through small decoders.

item.title: Paper summary: Qwen-AgentWorld: Language World Models for General Agents
item.description: Qwen-AgentWorld models are language world models that predict how agent environments respond across 7 domains, trained on 10M+ real interaction trajectories, and are reported to outperform frontier models at simulation on a new benchmark.

item.title: Generative AI · Diffusion models
item.description: DDPM from scratch on 2-D data: a fixed forward process that adds Gaussian noise, a small network trained to predict that noise, and a reverse loop that turns pure noise back into data.

item.title: Generative AI · DCGAN
item.description: The DCGAN architecture guidelines (strided convolutions, batch norm, ReLU/LeakyReLU, no pooling or fully connected hidden layers) built in PyTorch, with the tensor shapes traced from noise to a 32×32 image.

item.title: Paper summary: JoyAI-VL-Interaction: Real-Time Vision-Language Interaction Intelligence
item.description: JoyAI-VL-Interaction is an open 8B vision-language model that watches a live video stream and decides each second whether to stay silent, respond, or hand off to a bigger background model.

item.title: Paper summary: ABot-Earth 0.5: Generative 3D Earth Model
item.description: ABot-Earth 0.5 generates large, seamless 3D Gaussian Splatting environments from satellite images alone, at under 10 minutes per square kilometre, viewable in web map engines and usable as a simulator for UAV navigation.

item.title: Generative AI · GANs
item.description: A generator and a discriminator trained against each other; the minimax game written out, a small GAN learning a 2-D ring of Gaussians, and the mode-collapse failure it can fall into.

item.title: Gemma 4 12B: an encoder-free multimodal model for laptops
item.description: Google introduced Gemma 4 12B, a mid-sized open model where vision and audio inputs flow straight into the LLM backbone with no separate encoders; it runs in 16GB and ships with multi-token-prediction drafters.

item.title: Paper summary: On the Scaling of PEFT: Towards Million Personal Models of Trillion Parameters
item.description: This position-style study argues that small adapters on top of shared foundation models can serve as persistent personal state (preferences, skills, tool habits, memory-like updates), organised along Scale Up, Scale Down and Scale Out axes.

item.title: Generative AI · Variational autoencoders
item.description: A VAE learns a smooth latent space by encoding inputs as distributions and decoding samples from them; a small VAE on handwritten digits, the reparameterisation trick, and generating new digits from noise.

item.title: Paper summary: Gamma-World: Generative Multi-Agent World Modeling Beyond Two Players
item.description: Gamma-World is a generative world model for interactive video with many simultaneously controlled agents, using a parameter-free simplex rotary agent encoding and hub-token attention, distilled for real-time 24 FPS generation.

item.title: LangChain · LangSmith
item.description: What LangSmith records (traces of every run, with inputs, outputs, latency and errors) and how it's enabled; locally I captured the same run tree with a callback handler, without sending anything to a hosted service.

item.title: Gemini 3.5 Flash: agents and coding at Flash speed
item.description: Google DeepMind introduced Gemini 3.5 with 3.5 Flash first, reporting it beats Gemini 3.1 Pro on agentic and coding benchmarks (Terminal-Bench 2.1 76.2%, MCP Atlas 83.6%) at about 4× the output speed of other frontier models.

item.title: LangChain · LangGraph
item.description: LangGraph models an application as a state machine: typed state, nodes that update it, and conditional edges, used here to build a small corrective-retrieval loop that rewrites the query when retrieval looks weak.

item.title: Paper summary: Code as Agent Harness
item.description: A survey that treats code as the infrastructure of agents, not just their output: the interface agents act through, the mechanism for planning, memory and verification, and the shared artefact that coordinates multiple agents.

item.title: Paper summary: MinT: Managed Infrastructure for Training and Serving Millions of LLMs
item.description: MinT is infrastructure for training and serving many LoRA policies on a few shared base-model deployments, moving only adapters through rollout, update, evaluation and serving, scaled past 1T-parameter bases and toward million-adapter catalogues.

item.title: LangChain · RAG
item.description: Retrieval-augmented generation end to end with LCEL: retrieve chunks from my own notes, stuff them into a grounded prompt, answer with a local model, and return the sources with the answer.

item.title: LangChain · Vector stores
item.description: Embedding chunks with a local sentence-transformer, storing them in LangChain's InMemoryVectorStore, similarity search with scores, metadata filters, and turning the store into a retriever.

item.title: Paper summary: MolmoAct2: Action Reasoning Models for Real-world Deployment
item.description: MolmoAct2 is a fully open action-reasoning model for practical robot deployment, with a new embodied-reasoning VLM backbone, open datasets including 720 hours of bimanual teleoperation, an open action tokenizer, and a lower-latency reasoning variant.

item.title: LangChain · Text splitters
item.description: Why documents are split into chunks for retrieval, how RecursiveCharacterTextSplitter tries paragraph, then sentence, then word boundaries, and what chunk size and overlap do.

item.title: Paper summary: Recursive Multi-Agent Systems
item.description: RecursiveMAS treats a whole multi-agent system as one recursive computation in latent space, linking agents with a light RecursiveLink module and training them jointly; it reports +8.3% accuracy and 1.2–2.4× faster inference.
